headline: By 03 §1 and Lemma B, FW-H2(E_q, q) ⟺ FW-H2(E, q), and at a good ordinary prime that is 10's congruence. All 19 members are good and ordinary at q; exactly 1 has a_q² ≡ 1 (mod q): q = 3529, a_q = 1, confirmed by three independent counts. So the provisional FW-at-every-odd-p design FAILS H2 at member 3529's own twisting prime; 27's revised router does not use FW at p = q and is untouched on its face. RUN-038 had listed 3529 as an obstruction prime since RUN-038. The verdict is conditional on three cited facts and carries the profile LEMMA_B_REDUCTION, not 07's FW17_EXACT
